fusions.name: Breakers Thunder In
fusions.desc: Sends a wave in a cone 4 tiles long ahead of you that deals 30 damage to everything in it, and every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lance at Full Tilt
fusions.desc: Throws a lance at an enemy up to 7 tiles away; it deals 7 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and 5% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%). It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Gallop Over Swell
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 35% for 8 seconds, and you start it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Headway
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
